prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a side impact at intersection. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1407; do not mention it.)
text:
This office represents the above-named individual in connection with injuries sustained in a side-impact collision at an intersection involving a vehicle insured under your policy. Our client was seriously hurt in the incident, and we ask that your insured and all adjusters and representatives direct any further communication regarding this claim exclusively to this firm. Please do not contact our client directly, either by telephone, in writing, or in person.

We request that you disclose the full liability and any applicable umbrella or excess coverage limits under the policy in force at the time of the accident, along with the declarations page. Please also provide written confirmation of the claim number assigned to this matter.

We further ask that your company preserve all evidence relating to the collision, including vehicle data and event recorder information, photographs, recorded statements, witness contact details, dispatch and repair records, and any surveillance or dashcam footage. Please suspend any routine deletion or destruction of such materials until this matter is fully resolved.
